title: Guangdong Museum
geometryBasis: Native wall perimeter, architect-published building height, and cleared aerial photograph of the roof, south and west elevations.
sectionBasis: Elevated charcoal metal panel shell with irregular deep red geometric recesses, set-back entrance and glazed central atrium roof within a broad recessed well.
limitations: The roof and the south and west elevations draw directly from the cleared aerial perspective. Pattern dimensions, glazing divisions and recessed depths are approximate, particularly on the north and east faces.
The source grade is reproduced at provider resolution. The entry deck and planted verge are simplified architectural geometry. Interior exhibits and adjacent buildings are outside the model scope.
